scenes.text: Hello there, my little hopping pals! I'm Funny Bunny, and I'm super excited to be with you today. We're going on a delightful adventure about changes and transitions. Ever wonder why things change, like when day turns into night or when you grow a little taller? Well, we're going to explore all that fun stuff together! So, are you ready to hop along with me? Let's get started on this amazing journey!

Now, let's think about what a transition is. It's just a fancy word for change! Like when you switch from playing with toys to having a yummy snack. Or when the seasons change from sunny summer to chilly winter. Transitions happen all around us, even when we don't notice. They're like little surprises that keep life interesting! Can you think of a change you've seen today?

Transitions can be fun and sometimes a bit tricky. But don't worry, we can learn how to handle them together! One way is by being curious and asking questions. Like, why do leaves change color in the fall? Or, how does a caterpillar become a butterfly? Being curious helps us understand and enjoy the changes around us. Let's keep our eyes open for new things!

Great job being curious, my little friends! You can do it! Now, let's try a fun exercise to help us with transitions. Imagine you're a tree with branches. When the wind blows, your branches sway gently. Let's sway side to side together. Ready, set, sway! Feel how nice it is to move and change? You're doing wonderfully!

Remember when we swayed like trees? That was a fun way to practice handling change. Now, let's talk about another important transition—going to bed! At night, we say goodbye to the sun and hello to the moon. It's a time to rest and dream. But first, we brush our teeth and put on cozy pajamas. These little steps make the transition to bedtime smooth and comfy.

Let's learn about morning transitions too! When we wake up, it's time to say good morning to the sun. We stretch our arms and legs, just like a sleepy cat. Then, we get ready for the day by brushing our teeth and having a healthy breakfast. These steps help us feel awake and ready to play. Do you have a favorite morning routine?

You're doing amazing with all these transitions! Now, let's play a game. Imagine you're a bunny, just like me, hopping from one thing to another. Let's hop in place, counting to five. One, two, three, four, five! Hopping helps us move from one fun activity to the next. Great hopping, everyone!

Next, let's talk about a big transition—going to school or daycare. It might feel a little scary at first, but it's also exciting. You get to meet new friends and learn new things! It's like starting a new adventure every day. Remember, it's okay to feel a bit nervous. With time, you'll feel just like a brave explorer!

Can you think of a time when you were brave during a big change? Maybe it was trying a new food or meeting a new friend. How did it feel? Being brave and trying new things can be so rewarding. I'm curious to hear about your brave moments!

Let's continue our adventure with another transition—changing seasons! When winter turns to spring, flowers bloom, and everything feels fresh and new. It's like nature is singing a happy song. Have you ever noticed how the air smells different in each season? It's one of nature's wonderful surprises!

Speaking of surprises, have you ever found a hidden treasure in the garden? Like a shiny pebble or a colorful leaf? Nature is full of little treasures waiting to be discovered. Next time you're outside, keep your eyes open for nature's surprises. Who knows what you'll find!

You're doing fantastic, my little explorers! Let's take a deep breath together. Inhale... and exhale. Breathing helps us feel calm and ready for anything. Whenever you feel a big change coming, remember to breathe. You've got this!

Now, let's talk about family changes. Sometimes, families grow with new siblings or pets. It's a big transition, but it's also filled with love and joy. You get to share new experiences and make wonderful memories together. Isn't it amazing how families change and grow?

Do you have a special memory of a family change? Maybe a fun trip or a new pet joining your home. How did it make you feel? Sharing these memories with your family is a great way to remember the happy times. I'd love to hear about your special memories!

What an amazing journey we've had learning about transitions! Remember, change is like a big adventure filled with surprises and new things to learn. Whenever you face a change, know that you have the tools to handle it. You can breathe, be curious, and be brave. I'm so proud of you, my little friends. Until next time, keep hopping along and enjoying the journey. Goodbye, and have a wonderful day!
